Senses.Explanation: To take an oath is to establish a stated commitment and then act under it. Fu Dashi’s record narrates his oath to continue the true teaching and deliver beings. Two biographies make the following conduct explicit: one biographical subject vows not to enter lay houses, and another removes his sitting stool and vows not to sit until awakening. These documentary scenes show commitment followed by conduct; they do not establish a general contrast with every private wish.
